description: A hash mismatch floors the shipped manifest and nothing else: the overlay and the override are independent of the package's files, so their keys still answer while the manifest's own go to the floor that names the stale file.

diagnostics.message: Call to `shipped` escapes this `@nothrow` function: it is colored by a `nothrow.json` that no longer matches its package's files — `./index.js` has changed since the manifest was written — so the manifest is ignored and no surviving `@nothrow` tag colors it either. Your outs, in precedence order: bridge this call with `try`/`catch`; assert the color in `nothrow.overrides.json`; install or write an `@no-throw/*` overlay; or, if you own the package, ship a manifest with `nothrow emit`.
